rounds.text: Flora Corporation Ltd demonstrates a compelling long-term growth trajectory, evidenced by a 10-year compounded sales growth rate of 85% [E14]. This momentum is supported by consistent medium-term performance, with 5-year and 3-year compounded sales growth rates of 20% and 32% respectively [E15, E16], significantly outpacing the sector median sales growth of 12.9% [E70]. The market currently undervalues these fundamental achievements, as the stock trades at a modest price-to-book ratio of 1.38x [E2]. Furthermore, the company is beginning to outperform market expectations, with profit growth exceeding 1-year price growth by 214% [E54]. Conceded: [E4, E5, E6, E17, E64, E65]. Despite recent volatility, the company maintains a superior return on assets of 1.63% compared to the sector benchmark of 1.54% [E8].

blind_spot_facts.fact: P/B of 2.21x against a sector benchmark of 1.51x.
